description: AND-02: money-path dossier with an injected population client (via extra_config.population in the test) that returns a CohortAggregate whose cohort_id/dataset_ref are BOTH clean but whose metrics carry a PHI-bearing CELL NAME ('paciente_CPF-12345678901', a synthetic CPF-length digit run) over a cohort-of-one (cohort_size=1, k_anonymity=1). Before AND-02 the egress gate tested only the PRESENCE of a k (k_anonymity < 1) and copied metrics verbatim, so this cell name egressed into actuarial_aggregate, the dossier and the approver's prompt. Andre's egress chokepoint (_scrub_aggregate) MUST block the whole aggregate and route to human_review (phi_egress_risk). Proves the ADR-0006/0019 structural PHI-egress guarantee reaches INSIDE metrics. Synthetic canary only.
recorded_llm: Agregado de coorte bloqueado por indicio de PHI resolvivel no nome de celula; dossie de pagamento encaminhado para revisao humana conservadora.
